rules.sentence: The largest problem with PMNC is the difficulty in differentiating whether or not it is a compressive neuropathy.

The aim of this review is to summarize the existing literature on PMNC, examine the variations of this condition, identify related symptoms and signs, and help physicians in diagnosing and treating PMNC.
